scope: THREE bounded source tasks; NO aggregate animal welfare score or untouched leaderboard
grouping_rule: Never treat repeated minutes, cows or cattle scores as independent study sites

tasks.input: 12 author camera-derived count channels for the current minute
tasks.reference: independent electronic feeder current-minute positive intake
tasks.split: 16 train pigs, 4 calibration pigs, 4 test pigs (same farm/study)
tasks.primary_metric: heldout pig-cluster Brier and feeder-episode detection

tasks.reference: human video-reviewed choice grazing, walking, resting, ruminating
tasks.split: 16/4/4 cow-disjoint; plus two directional whole-site exploratory transfers
tasks.primary_metric: heldout cow-cluster multiclass Brier with macro F1 secondary

tasks.input: breed, lactation number and days in milk; no observed gait or milk production
tasks.reference: original human clinical gait score >=3; BCS independent second family
tasks.primary_metric: farm-unweighted Brier gain over train-farm prior
